blinding_guess.why: The publisher strips the node's effective namespace plus the following separator (ns_len > 1 ? ns_len + 1 : ns_len) before turning the base topic into a dotted prefix, so the three listed parameters come out without a leading dot (camera.image_raw.compressed.*), with a deprecation shim for the old dot-prefixed names; the declared names, types and defaults look internally consistent. The subscriber's own mode parameter still uses substr(ns_len) without the +1, but that is not a listed element.

notes: The snapshot holds the whole image_transport_plugins tree; only snapshot/compressed_image_transport/ was used. Parameter names are assembled at run time: CompressedPublisher::advertiseImpl takes the resolved base_topic, drops the first (ns_len > 1 ? ns_len + 1 : ns_len) characters where ns_len = node->get_effective_namespace().length() (compressed_publisher.cpp:144-146), replaces '/' with '.' (line 147), and declareParameter forms <base>.<transport>.<name> (lines 389-390) with transport name "compressed" (compressed_publisher.hpp:60-63). The packet names therefore correspond to a base topic camera/image_raw relative to the node's namespace; the suffixes .compressed.format/.jpeg_quality/.png_level and the types are fixed in code. Declared defaults and constraints: format default "jpeg", additional_constraints "Supported values: [jpeg, png, tiff]" (lines 64-70); png_level default 3, integer range 0..9 step 1 (lines 73-83); jpeg_quality default 95, integer range 1..100 step 1 (lines 86-96). When the effective namespace length is > 1 the code also declares deprecated dot-prefixed duplicates (e.g. .camera.image_raw.compressed.format, lines 403-415) and registers a pre-set-parameters callback that mirrors values between the dotted and undotted names (lines 149-154, 418-443); these duplicates are not packet elements and are not listed in declares. If a name is already declared, declareParameter catches ParameterAlreadyDeclaredException and reads the existing value (lines 398-401). QoS is null for all ports: parameters declared through rclcpp::Node::declare_parameter carry no QoS, and the api element is a function call. cfg/CompressedPublisher.cfg is a ROS 1 dynamic_reconfigure file with different defaults (jpeg_quality 80, png_level 9, formats jpeg/png only); CMakeLists.txt (ament_cmake) does not reference it, so it was not treated as the declaration. The subscriber (compressed_subscriber.cpp:83-85) computes its own parameter prefix with base_topic.substr(ns_len), without the +1 used by the publisher; this affects only its mode parameter, which is not a packet element. references lists only the packet's consumed element; the code also uses sensor_msgs/msg/Image, sensor_msgs/msg/CompressedImage and other rclcpp APIs, which are not enumerated. No dependency definition files were fetched (none of the elements is a message type).
